## Checklist
- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has unit tests
- [ ] No new network calls, analytics or ad SDKs
- [ ] No real private files, keys or personal data in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] User-visible strings added to all translated `strings.xml` files (English fallback is fine)
- [ ] I agree to the contribution terms in CONTRIBUTING.md
